extension.summary: Founders Theater: a community Kodi add-on for Silo
extension.description: Founders Theater is a community add-on for Silo media servers, not an official Silo app. Browse your Silo library with a TV interface modeled on the Silo Android TV app, choose a media file and resume movies and episodes from your saved position.
extension.disclaimer: Founders Theater is not made or endorsed by the Silo project. Select HDR and Dolby Vision settings that your device and display support.
extension.news: v1.0.0 (2026-11-23) - A new Founders Theater icon for the add-on, its widgets and its repository. - Play next goes straight into the next episode in the version closest to the one you were watching, without asking which file. - The Collections row on Home shows again, and All movies and All series list the collections of every library plus your own. - Ratings use Silo's 1 to 10 scale, shown as stars, so they match the other Silo apps. - Media info no longer shows a made-up file name when the server keeps file names private. - The Favorite button shows a proper heart. - Silo's sessions and devices list this Kodi by its own name. - Playback reports reach Silo with their session, and server replies are compressed.
